283488031.description: This mineral specimen features light green, translucent cubic apophyllite crystals alongside peach-colored stilbite clusters on a dark gray matrix. The apophyllite crystals exhibit a glassy luster and well-formed cubic shapes. Stilbite crystals are fan-shaped and creamy peach in color. The specimen is unbranded and likely sourced from a mineral or rock collection. It is suitable for display or educational use. The piece is in natural condition with minor imperfections typical of hand-collected minerals. No significant damage or repairs are present.

283396162.description: This lot includes four vintage used vacuum tubes from National brand: 2C39 and 7289 models. Made in the USA, these tubes feature metal and ceramic construction. They were typically used as radio frequency power amplifiers in industrial, military, and amateur radio equipment. Tubes show signs of wear and oxidation, with handwritten notes on bases indicating previous use and condition, such as 'R. Final 2C39 5-20-85 USED' and '+V.G.++'. All tubes appear structurally intact but are sold as used and may require testing or refurbishment before operational use. Suitable for collectors, restorers, or those needing period-correct replacements for vintage RF or transmitter gear. not tested
